summary: Short narrow lane under dense trees; no clear ground to pull off.
reasons: Narrow lane, trees and fences both sides
Only 27 m, no room beside the lane
Homes 15-23 m away on both sides

drivers.seclusion: Dense canopy hides the lane, and nearest homes are 15 m or more away, but houses sit on both sides.
drivers.access_and_room: Single narrow sealed lane between trees and garden edges; no pull-off or verge wide enough for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet cul-de-sac style lane, little traffic.
drivers.convention: No parked cars on this stretch; residents' street with no overnight convention.

flags: Creek about 5 m away: flood-prone, though elevation is about 30 m
